body:
simdesign-loadbind (track 5): sweeps tip load (50–400 N) and arm length (60–120 mm) of the laser-cut bracket to find when the buckling-factor ≥ 3 guard binds. It binds only at 120 mm arms; the old w/b ≤ 8 rule costs 14–25% mass in five of six cases. Stylised, two seeds, preliminary.
